prototypeScope: V1.35 delta package: one Orange plate with the two parts of the A7Z saddle V3, body and lid (D-028). The V1.29 saddle body and lid of the V1.33 White plate are superseded; orange is the interim colour until white PLA is restocked.
knownFitBoundary: Board + Radxa 6530B screwed from below with four M2 x 6 through the saddle floor bosses (head pockets dia 4.2 from below to z 46.5) and the board holes into the heatsink's threaded bosses, making saddle, board and heatsink one unit; the two roof screws S-shell_pack-01/02 are driven into the pack bar before the unit is taped on (floor underside passes about 0.1 mm over their heads, ray cast 2026-10-25); the unit is held by 3M 0.5 mm foam tape under the floor edges, no screw; the lid is a cover held by two M2 x 6 side screws at z 64.2 whose bosses end 1.0 mm above the heatsink. 6530B base height (3.1) and fin-block start (d 6.4) are photo estimates, measured on the part before fitting. Printed sizes not measured.
processOverrideReason: The V1.17 White support-interface overrides (3 interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer) applied to the Orange plate: the saddle body stands on tree support over its whole underside, as the printed V1.29 body did on White.
